title.value: Maintenance Cost of Software Ecosystem Updates
title.justification: The title chosen reflects the focus of the paper on analyzing the maintenance costs associated with software ecosystem updates, which is a central theme discussed throughout the document.
title.quote: Maintenance Cost of Software Ecosystem Updates

extractions.description: This paper quantifies the maintenance cost of software ecosystem updates by leveraging software release metadata. It presents a model to calculate the maintenance cost in Industry 4.0 contexts and evaluates the model using three specific use cases.

primary_category.justification: The paper is primarily focused on software maintenance within Industry 4.0 and does not directly relate to eco-responsible AI categories.
primary_category.quote: This paper leverages software release metadata to quantify the maintenance cost of software ecosystem updates.

secondary_categories.justification: The focus remains on software maintenance and does not tangibly relate to eco-responsibility themes specified in the provided categories.
secondary_categories.quote: Maintenance Cost of Software Ecosystem Updates

primary_sub_category.justification: Sub-categories relevant to eco-responsible AI do not apply as the paper focuses on software maintenance costs.
primary_sub_category.quote: The model is applied to industry use cases focusing on software maintenance costs.

secondary_sub_categories.justification: There is no relevant eco-responsible sub-category applicable to the content of this paper.
secondary_sub_categories.quote: Maintenance Cost of Software Ecosystem Updates

applications.justification: The paper specifically addresses the use of software metadata to evaluate maintenance costs within Industry 4.0 settings, demonstrating its application in real-world industry scenarios.
applications.quote: In Section 4, the model prototype implementation is illustrated and applied to three Industry 4.0 use cases.

new_primary_category.justification: The paper suggests a focus that doesn't align with traditional eco-responsible categories but instead fits within the domain of software engineering for industrial applications.
new_primary_category.quote: This paper leverages software release metadata to quantify the maintenance cost of software ecosystem updates... applied to Industry 4.0 domains.

new_primary_sub_category.justification: The focus is on the cost estimation and maintenance of software ecosystems, which doesn't fit the provided sub-categories but aligns with this newly suggested sub-category.
new_primary_sub_category.quote: The model provides a maintenance cost for both, the ecosystem and ecosystem component.
